about: Sonar Tactics: one power per ship, in fleet order. A power is ready when its charge reaches the cooldown; every move you make adds 1 charge, using it resets it to 0, and it starts at half the cooldown. A sunk ship's power is gone. levels = Mk I, Mk II, Mk III. size: air_strike = squares hit, salvo = shots, radar = lines (always 1), torpedo = edges it can start from (2 = left/top, 4 = any), flare = 5 (+ shape) or 9 (3x3).
about_extras: mines = how many each side may hide (on open water, not next to a ship). crates = hidden in each sea from the game seed; shooting one gives its item. combo = firing moves in a row that hit to fill Overdrive, which instantly charges one power and keeps your turn.

items.name: Extra ping
items.text: One more sonar ping against this sea.

items.name: Shield
items.text: Blocks the next shot that would hit one of your ships.

items.name: Repair kit
items.text: Fixes a hit square on one of your ships (or becomes a Shield if nothing needs fixing).

powers.name: Air Strike
powers.text: Fire at a line of squares in one go.

powers.name: Salvo
powers.text: Fire several shots anywhere this turn.

powers.name: Radar Sweep
powers.text: Count the ship squares in a whole row or column.

powers.name: Torpedo
powers.text: Runs in from the edge and hits the first ship it meets. Your sub also hides from pings and radar.

powers.name: Flare
powers.text: Lights up squares to show ship or water, without firing.
